title: Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Price Guarantee Terms
content:
Ridgeline Orders & Delivery credits a lower Ridgeline price on the same item during a set number of calendar days after the order date, and matches a local competitor's lower in-stock price on the identical item before purchase; the terms are the same under every fulfillment program.

| Fulfillment program | Days after the order date during which a lower Ridgeline price on the same item is credited (calendar days) | Clearance, open-box and limited-time special buy prices excluded from price adjustments | Local competitor's lower in-stock price on the identical item matched before purchase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | 30 | Yes | Yes |

**Questions the terms answer**

*Which Ridgeline prices count?* A lower Ridgeline price on the same item, unless it is a clearance, open-box or limited-time special buy price: those three are excluded under every program.

*How long after the order?* 30 calendar days after the order date, under every program. For an order dated 2026-04-06, a Ridgeline price lowered on 2026-04-20, 14 days after the order date, falls inside the period; one lowered on 2026-05-18, 42 days after, falls outside it. (Illustrative dates.)

*What about a competitor's price?* A local competitor's lower in-stock price on the identical item is matched under every program, and only before purchase.
